scheme_name: Swaran Jayanti Guru Darshan Yatra Scheme 2016
other_conditions: Completion of the Yatra must be through the State Government, Central Government, or an authorized Society with a completion certificate submitted by the respective authority
Financial assistance can be granted only once per pilgrim
Application must be submitted within two months after Yatra completion
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹6,000 or 50% of the actual expenditure per pilgrim, whichever is less.
